newsitem.title: UK: British Telecom shares advance on Q3 profits.
newsitem.headline: British Telecom shares advance on Q3 profits.

text.p: British Telecommunications Plc (BT) shares reversed early losses on Thursday after the company reported third-quarter profits near the top end of expectations and held an encouraging briefing for analysts, dealers said.
Dealers said Wall Street's weakness had spurred an early mark-down in the shares but they moved into positive territory after bullish comments from a number of analysts.
The shares were 3-1/2p firmer at 447-1/2 by 1141 GMT.
Analysts at ABN AMRO Hoare Govett said they had upgraded their full-year profit forecast for 1997 to 3.25 billion pounds from 3.1 billion.
BT posted third-quarter pre-tax profits of 909 million stg after a 39 million stg redundancy charge. Analysts had expected profits in the range 860-920 million stg.

"BT's had a very strong run in the last three months on the back of a big dividend they are paying shortly and the fact that cash flow is phenomenal," said Mike Stiles, analyst at Credit Lyonnais Laing. "But I think that's probably high enough for the time being."
